summary: NGA and ORNL project developments reported from January through March 2026.

entries.summary: Foundation Digital Twin work advanced toward the initial MVP demonstration.
items: Tested Digital Twin and NVIDIA Omniverse installation and launch from Lockheed on ORNL systems.
Briefed NGA on terrain-processing advances and delivered a test terrain product with GPM metadata.
Advanced integration of ImageSense, LandScan, and Global Building Intelligence capabilities with VSI and Lockheed.

entries.summary: Advanced edge-to-twin integration for UXO detection and MAPSTER notifications.
items: Conducted a data-collection campaign with the U.S. Army 744th EOD at Fort Campbell.
Built labeled RGB and thermal datasets and trained a UXO detection model.
Uploaded model weights to MAPSTER and nearly completed the AOI-based data-notification API.

entries.summary: Updated the ImageSense source catalog and standardized metadata to improve imagery traceability and analyst workflows.
items: Expanded access to social-media imagery for post-conflict ground-level observations.
Began shifting emphasis toward geolocation accuracy and satellite-orthophoto alignment.
Provided Ukraine AOI satellite orthophotography for ground-to-orthophoto matching evaluation.

entries.summary: Expanded Population Density Table observations and refined country-level occupancy reporting.
items: Developed 25 new building-level observations across six countries.
Updated five existing reports, all within Japan.
Drafted methodology and documentation for the initial global popularity-data collection pass.

entries.summary: Advanced LandScan population, demographic, historical, and crisis-update workflows.
items: Established a technical plan for grid-cell uncertainty quantification.
Started automated feature-extraction workflows at 30- and 3-arc-second resolutions using parquet outputs.
Produced a 34-category global age-gender raster and advanced demographic uncertainty modeling.
Delivered Rapid Updates for Gaza and Ukraine.

entries.summary: Resumed Nautical Charts project work and updated DALE for SPOCC-compliant development and deployment.
items: Removed unnecessary software dependencies and updated remaining dependencies.
Modified the DALE environment and CI/CD pipeline in the NGA GitLab repository.
Assumed ORNL responsibility for maintaining DALE in NGA's development environment.
Identified trial S-101 ENC cells from the United Kingdom, Canada, and Germany for initial assessment.

entries.summary: Scoped the next Tango Blue benchmarking phase for evaluating a commercial HPC solution.
items: Aligned tasking and deliverables with the Statement of Work.
Coordinated access to commercial software.
Assembled candidate datasets and evaluation metrics for benchmarking and recommendations.

entries.summary: Demonstrated the Foundation Digital Twin using integrated ORNL and partner-generated datasets.
items: Integrated LandScan, ImageSense, and Global Building Intelligence with Real 3D mesh products from VSI and Lockheed.
Hosted the demonstration through NVIDIA Omniverse.

entries.summary: Expanded Digital Twin edge integration for mine detection and automated UAS data delivery.
items: Added a mine-detection model to MAPSTER.
Enabled automated UAS data delivery from edge Ammo Can to the MAPSTER main server.

entries.summary: Advanced Building Damage Indicators model validation and operational workflow testing.
items: Secured access to WorldView Legion imagery over Tehran.
Found that building polygon and mapping models generalized well across Legion and WorldView-02 imagery.
Identified sensor sensitivity in BDI models and began targeted fine-tuning.
Started end-to-end workflow testing on NTM imagery in the classified environment.

entries.summary: Released ARGUS 1.6.0 with terrain-processing, provenance, precision, and CUDA updates.
items: Fixed equator-crossing coordinate conversion.
Improved DSM void-filling controls and provenance outputs.
Added GPM XML and per-pixel CE90/LE90 error-product support.
Updated CUDA 12.6 support and improved registration and GeoTIFF precision handling.

entries.summary: Deployed the Precision Imagery automation container to NGA HPCaaS.
items: Automated image tie-point collection and bundle adjustment.
Integrated the tie-point application into the existing workflow.
Used the triangulation application for downstream product production.
Added standard triangulation file outputs for independent product use.

entries.summary: Advanced LandScan global, Mosaic, Rapid Updates, and Myriad capabilities.
items: Integrated uncertainty quantification into the 2025 production pipeline.
Completed global backcasted building-level population estimates for 1975–2025.
Advanced roads-based modeling of non-building populations.
Demonstrated a validated synthetic population for Western Visayas and completed DHS Wealth Index predictions for Western Visayas and Jordan.
Operationalized the Myriad World Baseline as a command-line tool.

entries.summary: Advanced crisis-region population-update workflows and prepared multiple regional deliveries.
items: Completed final review of the March Gaza update and prepared it for delivery.
Completed BDI, building-feature-extraction, and damage-conflation workflows for Isfahan, Tehran, Beirut, and southern Lebanon.
Initiated a new Iran–Shiraz workflow and imagery collection.

entries.summary: Completed PDT SIPR server migration and expanded data-ingestion capabilities.
items: Installed the new server and backup system.
Ported all capabilities and interfaces with minimal end-user impact.
Implemented MIDB CATCODES in the UNCLASS PDT interface for review.
Expanded BURST capacity for large facility datasets.

entries.summary: Expanded and refreshed PDT building-occupancy observations and reports.
items: Developed 36 new observations across nine countries and five land-use classes.
Updated 3,598 existing reports across nine countries.

entries.summary: Participated in the Maritime Collateral Damage Estimation Working Group at Naval Air Station Fallon.
items: Contributed PDT density-table expertise to discussions of Maritime CDE requirements and processes.
Supported alignment between maritime and established land-based CDE methodologies.

entries.summary: Resumed prioritized PlanetSense POI refresh operations and expanded global reprocessing.
items: Prioritized countries with the oldest update dates.
Initiated broader reprocessing beginning with Africa.
Ingested current FourSquare OS and Overture releases.
Completed ODMAP collection for the New Jersey Delta area of interest and continued Baidu China collection.

entries.summary: Completed initial PlanetSense POI conflation methodology development in Pagadian City, Philippines.
items: Used Global Building Intelligence footprints for POI deduplication and POI-to-building conflation.
Reduced the POI dataset by 13.8 percent.
Produced 3,372 contextualized buildings.

entries.summary: Advanced S-101 electronic navigational chart research and DALE S-57 maintenance.
items: Reviewed the S-100 universal hydrographic data model and S-101 product specification.
Developed an S-101 reader and received a large batch of S-101 ENCs from NGA.
Updated a DALE dependency to meet SPOCC requirements.
Continued preparation of DALE 1.0.2 for deployment.

entries.summary: Refined Midnight Blue HPC survey analysis and benchmarking plans.
items: Identified representative GEOINT workflow candidates.
Refined KPI definitions and confirmed repeatable benchmarking assumptions.
Prepared the pilot instrumentation approach for baseline-versus-optimized performance characterization.

entries.summary: Finalized the FIVEKAY work plan and began documenting the test-and-evaluation framework.
items: Reviewed and revised the remainder-of-period-of-performance work plan using sponsor feedback.
Completed two TA-1 mission summaries and submitted them for DC review.
